guide.dashboard_1: Open the app and log in with your OTP.
guide.dashboard_2: The Home tab shows your total classes, students, and programmes.
guide.dashboard_3: Scroll down to see "My Classrooms" — tap any row to open that classroom.
guide.classrooms_1: Tap the Classrooms tab or tap a classroom on the Home screen.
guide.classrooms_2: The classroom detail shows two sections: PROGRAMMES and STUDENTS.
guide.classrooms_3: Under PROGRAMMES, tap a programme to expand its learning units.
guide.classrooms_4: Under STUDENTS, tap a student row to expand their submission status.
guide.submit_title: Making a Submission (on behalf of a student)
guide.submit_1: Open a classroom and scroll to the STUDENTS section.
guide.submit_2: Tap a student's row to expand it.
guide.submit_3: Find the learning unit with a teal "Submit" button.
guide.submit_5: Type the evidence in the text field.
guide.submit_6: Optionally tap "Add Photo" to attach a photo.
guide.submit_8: The button changes to a teal "Submitted" chip — submission is recorded.
guide.review_1: Open a classroom and scroll to the STUDENTS section.
guide.review_2: Tap a student's row to expand it.
guide.review_3: Learning units that have been submitted show a teal "Submitted" chip.
guide.review_4: Tap the "Submitted" chip (or the "View" button) to open the submission.
guide.review_5: The review dialog shows: evidence text, any attached photos, submission date/time, and whether it was submitted by the teacher or the student.
guide.lu_1: Open a classroom and find the PROGRAMMES section.
guide.lu_2: Tap a programme to expand its learning units.
guide.lu_3: Tap a learning unit row (with the book icon) to open its detail page.
guide.lu_4: The detail page shows the LU name, category, description, and any resources.
guide.profile_1: Tap the Profile tab or tap your avatar (initials) at the top of the Home screen.
guide.profile_2: Profile shows your name, institution, and total classroom count.
guide.profile_3: Notifications — toggle push notifications on or off.
guide.profile_4: Offline Mode — when on, the app caches data for use without internet.
guide.profile_5: Language — choose from English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and more.
guide.profile_6: Sign Out — safely log out of the app.
guide.reminder_1: When a learning unit is scheduled to a month, you will receive a WhatsApp message 7 days before the 1st of that month.
guide.reminder_2: For example, if a learning unit is scheduled for June, you'll receive the reminder on 24th May.
guide.reminder_3: The message shows the learning unit name and the scheduled month.
guide.reminder_4: Tap "All set" if you are prepared to conduct the activity.
guide.reminder_5: Tap "I have questions" if you need support — your Programme Executive will be notified by email and will contact you.
guide.pe_1: You can also request support directly from the app.
guide.pe_2: Open any learning unit from a classroom.
guide.pe_3: Tap the "Connect with PE" button near the bottom of the screen.
guide.pe_4: Confirm in the dialog — your Programme Executive will be notified by email.
guide.pe_5: Your PE will reach out to schedule a call or chat with you.
guide.access_1: Students whose names are not yet filled in the system are shown by their access code (e.g. 1001203006001).
guide.access_2: The access code is the student's login username.
guide.access_3: Share the access code with the student so they can log in to the unLab app.
guide.more_body: Contact your programme coordinator or ThinkTac support.

quizzes.no_classroom: କୁଇଜ୍ ଦେବାକୁ ଏକ ଶ୍ରେଣୀରୁ ଏହି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ।
quizzes.title: କୁଇଜ୍ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତିଯୋଗିତା
quizzes.none_in_classroom: ଏହି ଶ୍ରେଣୀରେ ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ କୌଣସି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ନାହିଁ।
quizzes.no_classrooms_subtitle: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଖାତା ସହ ଶ୍ରେଣୀ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯିବା ପରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଏଠାରେ ଦେଖାଯିବ।
quizzes.unsupported_question: ଏହି ପ୍ରକାରର ପ୍ରଶ୍ନର ଉତ୍ତର ଏହି ଆପରେ ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଦିଆଯାଇପାରିବ ନାହିଁ।
quizzes.no_questions_subtitle: ଏହି କୁଇଜ୍‌ରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦେବାକୁ କୌଣସି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ନାହିଁ।
quizzes.cap_reached: ଏହି ଶ୍ରେଣୀ ଓ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ପାଇଁ ଅନୁମତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ସମସ୍ତ ଦାଖଲ ସରିଯାଇଛି। ଏହି ପ୍ରୟାସ ସଞ୍ଚୟ ହୋଇନାହିଁ।
quizzes.submit_failed: ଏହି ପ୍ରୟାସ ସଞ୍ଚୟ କରାଯାଇପାରିଲା ନାହିଁ। କିଛି ରେକର୍ଡ ହୋଇନାହିଁ।
quizzes.no_teacher_record: ଏହି ଖାତା କୌଣସି ଶିକ୍ଷକ ରେକର୍ଡ ସହ ସଂଯୁକ୍ତ ନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରୟାସ ସଞ୍ଚୟ କରାଯାଇପାରିବ ନାହିଁ।
quizzes.marked_by_teacher: ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ହୁଏ, ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ନମ୍ବର ନାହିଁ।
